_comment: The concepts the Dictionary shows (Settings › Dictionary) and that a user's Tapestry Assistant authors local copies of. Each is a community concept, named by its kind-39998 header coordinate — never by event id, which changes on every republish. Decision 2026-10-01: start with two concepts, GitHub Accounts and URLs; URLs has no community concept yet (see _pending).

concepts._search: Search finds this list's items when the words name it — 'github vcavallo' (lib/listSearch, components/search/ListItemResults). Shown to everyone, signed in or not (2026-10-05); Settings › Dictionary stays admin-only.
concepts._coordinate: GitHub Accounts — Avi Burra's header on dcosl.brainstorm.world. It declares one field (required github-username, text), while its items also carry an undeclared description. Decision 2026-10-01: use Avi's header as it stands; if Brainstorm wants different fields it makes its own local copy (a b-pointer to this one), not a replacement.

concepts._role: PROVISIONAL (2026-10-01): URL Templates — Vinney's canonical list (self-b). Its items carry ["url-template", <RFC 6570 level-1 template>] and a name; a concept header pins one by event id with ["link", <id>, <relay>, <placeholder>, <field>, …] (lib/linkTemplates). Just another Dictionary concept: the template picker reads its governing list for the reader — their copy, their Assistant's, else this one.

concepts._coordinate: Food and Drink Places — Avi Burra's header (2026-10-05), over BTC Map / OpenStreetMap imports signed by Mise En Place, 4bded217… (5000+ kind-39999 items; the Dictionary reads up to 500 from each of index and hub). It declares every field its items carry, types the URL ones and gives display hints (title name, summary address, image image, link website), but pins no URL templates and has no list image. Not searchable: 'and' is a word of its name, so 'search' would make any query with 'and' in it name this list (lib/listSearch).

Divine Videos — Avi Burra's header (2026-10-09), over short videos from divine.video (150 kind-39999 items signed by 6b279fb2…, 2026-10-09; the header also covers classic Vines, though none are listed yet). Built for rendering from the start: title title, summary creator, image thumbnail, media video (every item's an .mp4, so it plays in the page), six facts (handle, posted, seconds, platform, Vine loops and likes), a list icon, and two of Avi's URL templates — Divine video ({id} ← divine-id) and Divine profile ({npub} ← creator-npub).

Demo (2026-10-02): V4V Songs by the music curator, their reworked header (replaces …:da216f8f-6a99-460a-801c-62e7217f7acd, which declared no fields). This one names the concept and requires every field its kind-9999 items carry (t, title, artist, url, duration, feedId, feedGuid, artwork, alt) but types none and gives no display hints, so its first required field, t (a podcastindex URL), is what a song is titled by. Kept to show the team how an own version (field types, display hints, link and media roles) makes a list readable: songs get titles, cover art and an in-page player. Not one of the music tab's registered lists (config/dlists.config.json).

Demo (2026-10-02): Books — a header that declares no fields and no names (only a tapestry `json` tag), over Open Library imports whose items carry title, author, cover, isbn, year, pages, subject and open-library-id. A second demo of an own version turning an undeclared list into a readable one.

_pending: URLs — no kind-39998 URLs concept exists on any relay (searched dcosl, tags.brainstorm.world, staging, tapestry; 2026-10-01). Decision 2026-10-01: GitHub Accounts first, URLs once someone authors it. Its coordinate is permanent once copies point at it, so choose the author first.
